title: System Design Studio Note AST Document Schema
description: Standard schema for active-learning study notes synthesized in System Design Studio following the 4-phase cognitive contract.

topic_id.description: The canonical topic identifier, e.g. topic.0.1.tcp-vs-udp

title.description: Clean human-readable title of the topic

verified_date.description: ISO date string of topic sign-off (YYYY-MM-DD)

hypothesis.description: Phase 1: The learner's initial intuition and naive mental model prior to examining boundary conditions.

friction.description: Phase 2: The Socratic friction, edge cases, and failure modes where the naive mental model broke.

derived_invariant.description: Phase 3: The non-negotiable physical or mathematical invariant deduced and proven unassisted.

rules_of_thumb.description: Phase 4: Personal heuristics, operational decision rules, and production sizing bounds.

tradeoff.description: The fundamental tension or constraint (e.g. Ordering vs. Head-of-Line Blocking)

decision_rule.description: The actionable heuristic governing when to choose which architecture

production_bound.description: Physical sizing bound, formula limit, or operational threshold

formulas.description: Optional mathematical invariants, physical equations, or sizing calculations.

takeaways.description: Optional high-level production takeaways and architecture heuristics.
